title: McFlurry's FASTEST Pass Yet! Leroy 6 Second Runs & Ruby Returns
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-1:04:13; 129 segments). 0:00-1:38 sponsor; 1:03:50-end giveaway promo.

event_target.name: FL2K, October 2-5 at Bradenton Motorsports Park

giveaway.fact: 2025 F-250 Platinum, 2025 RTR Mustang (<600 mi, slightly damaged), 20 ft Eliminator tilt car hauler, $50,000 cash; $5 merch = entry

other.fact: Horn Blasters owner Matt's oddball turbo street car builds ~5 psi cruising at 60 mph; has scavenge-pump oil system and AC

cars.build_version: McFlurry - limited-turbo class car, World Cup prep

base_vehicle.note: not stated; 'orange Mustang' mentioned near its run is probably the opponent

engine.family: Ford Coyote (inferred from 'coyote RPMs' remark and spark-plug tubes in valve cover)

exhaust_backpressure.note: team rule of thumb: ~2:1 EMP:boost is where you run out of turbo; still headroom

chassis_fixes.desc: rear wheel runout ~35 thou vs claimed 30 thou axle tolerance
rear not square: passenger bar ~1/4 in longer, causing rear steer
25 lb hung off the back as ballast

passes.notes: went straight; sounded early-shift/bog; boost controller later found unplugged
turned up but no gain - dash boost-control switch unplugged (ran ~30 psi across the board)
boost controller fixed; quarter mile without hitting limiter; tires shaking/kicking off top end; ~156 mph eighth claimed strong vs 'ultra street' cars

failures.cause: oil leak; leaking spark plug tube on valve cover - done for night
dash switch unplugged after dash removal

tune.desc: same tune and clutch set as last outing; Pete sent a different traction control for pass 2 which slowed it in the eighth; turned up for pass 3

parachutes.desc: new parachutes from a different brand (previous maker sold; previous outing had a chute blowout); printed 'hell yeah brother'

passes.notes: floored to ~1000 ft (6.01 at 1000 ft per caption), then rolled out; estimated 6.88-6.91 if full pass
lifted after late grab of 4th gear (thought 3rd reached eighth)

cars.build_version: Ruby - 850 class prep with new driver
cars.owner_driver: Cleetus (tuner); driver George 'Squirrel' McNutt (first turbo car, first parachute pull)

launch.bump_box: bump function (also used as line lock, did not work)

passes.notes: first run: fuel pump cut out; same pump as Lumberjack
red light; parachute tangled; boost 20.7 psi
broke throttle cable/gas pedal on hard stab
fuel pump lost power up top; mph garbled ('15')

failures.cause: split out from hard throttle stab
